open_items: Actual inventory completeness, resource freshness under locks, durable prepared storage and final write authorization remain future transaction/CLI integration.
Specialized operation families, configured/partial scopes and new approval transitions need their dedicated trusted services.
Registered Python gates are trusted code, not authenticated or sandboxed by this adapter.

oracle.requirement_contract: Jeder tatsächlich ausgeführte `normative_write` MUSS den vollständigen geplanten Endstand einschließlich aller abhängigen Regeln vor `prepared` gegen seine befehlsspezifischen Gates validieren; die eng begrenzte Review-Ergebnisausnahme ist ausschließlich in Kapitel 11.13 definiert.
oracle.scope: Complete isolated target evaluation over a supplied closed project; missing core/command gates and dependent errors fail closed. Real plan/resource/base/result hashes are checked. No physical prepared transaction or write permission is issued. Direct preparation uses the same checked saved-plan path; whole-target command/resource gates also cover empty targets. Explicit historical reservations remain bound. Whole-target and dry-run field-reference checks additionally retain every available location and the project assessment decision; invalid stored relations retain the strict pre-plan boundary.

preconditions: Explicit closed project inventory, original configuration/resource bytes, bound effective profile and registered trusted model/command gates.
steps: Recompute ordered lifecycle candidates and their metadata, verify saved plan/base/target hashes, validate every supplied target artifact and inspect diff and direct impact.
